no_pick_reason: Ingen af dagens nyheder giver en ny fordel i universet, der ikke allerede er prissat. NVIDIAs opjusterede vækstudsigter og Anthropic-IPO'en er allerede reageret i kurserne efter torsdagens handel, Walmart falder trods hævet guidance, og Fed-referatet peger på flere renteforhøjelser, som trækker markedet ned bredt.

headlines.headline: Anthropic shares open on Nasdaq at $111.50, then close at $97.17 in first trading day as ANT
Anthropic prices IPO at $83 a share, above the $70-$78 range, valuing it at about $1.5 trillion
Nvidia raises sales growth outlook after results; shares rise more than 5% after hours, while CEO succession remains open
Walmart Q3 FY27 beats and raises FY27 outlook; shares fall about 1.9% premarket to $124.91
Fed minutes: almost all participants see further hikes as likely appropriate; Waller calls for a 50bp hike at the Dec 8-9 meeting
Oil slips on API crude build and Hormuz risk: Brent about $92.53, WTI about $84.77 (Nov 18 intraday)
S&P 500 falls 0.2% to 7,323.63, Dow drops 1.1%, Nasdaq gains 0.4% on Nvidia reversal (Nov 18 close)
Thanksgiving-week calendar: PCE and GDP revision Wed Nov 25, Beige Book 2pm, markets closed Thu Nov 26, early close Fri Nov 27
